audience: students, teachers and researchers who convert math-heavy images and PDFs to LaTeX or Markdown

useCases.title: Turn an equation in an image into LaTeX
useCases.text: Give the assistant the public URL of an image that holds a formula. It returns the math as LaTeX inside Mathpix Markdown. Mathpix bills each image.

useCases.title: Convert a PDF paper into Markdown
useCases.text: Submit a PDF from a public URL. Check the status until the job completes, then read the Markdown in slices. Mathpix bills per page processed.

useCases.title: Convert Mathpix Markdown into LaTeX or HTML
useCases.text: Convert Mathpix Markdown text into plain Markdown, HTML or LaTeX. Check the conversion status, then read the converted text. Mathpix may bill some conversions.

useCases.title: Find an earlier OCR result or document
useCases.text: List your stored image results and processed documents, newest first. Check that a document is completed, then read its text again without a new billed request.

useCases.title: Compare API usage with the Mathpix bill
useCases.text: Get the usage counts of your account by type, such as images or PDF pages, for a date range. Use the counts to check the Mathpix bill.

useCases.title: Delete a processed document you no longer need
useCases.text: List the processed documents and pick one to delete. The deletion removes its outputs and source copy at Mathpix. It is permanent, so read the output first.
